name: HEX_JOB_PREPROCESS_RANGE
description: The table stores the status of preprocess chunk progress.

columns.name: PREPROCESS_JOB_ID
columns.description: The column indicates the JOB_ID from the HEX_JOBS table.

columns.name: PARENT_JOB_ID
columns.description: The column indicates the parent job id for the current job.

columns.name: CHUNK_PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: The column indicates the current processing status of the chunk.

columns.name: CHUNK_NUMBER
columns.description: The column indicates the number of the chunk being processed.

columns.name: CHUNK_THREAD_NUMBER
columns.description: The column indicates the thread number processing the current chunk.

columns.name: THREAD_ESS_ID
columns.description: The column indicates the process request id for the thread.

columns.name: SEQ_NO
columns.description: The column indicates the unique sequence number associated with each chunk.

columns.name: START_VALUE
columns.description: The column indicates the start value within the range.

columns.name: END_VALUE
columns.description: The column indicates the end value within the range.

columns.name: PROCESSING_TYPE
columns.description: The column indicates the processing type. Valid values are PREPROCESS, PROCESS and POSTPROCESS.

columns.name: GROUP_TAG_VALUE
columns.description: The column indicates the value reference for the parent child link.

columns.name: GROUP_TAG_NUMBER
columns.description: The column indicates the number reference for the parent child link.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
